```{r, include=FALSE}
folder <- normalizePath(".") |> basename()
url <- sprintf("https://scienceverse.org/talks/%s/", folder)
link_display <- sprintf("![](images/scienceverse.png){height=300} ![](images/qrcode.svg){height=320 style='margin: 0 1em;'} ![](images/metacheck.png){height=300}\\n\\n[%s](%s)", url, url)
# make QR code
qrcode::qr_code(url) |> 
  qrcode::generate_svg("images/qrcode.svg", 
                       background = "#E9E8E5", # bg-color from scss
                       foreground = "black")
```
---
title: "Open Code Needs Open Checks"
